headline: Kesoram Industries CFO Samir Kumar Ray resigns effective January 2027
summary: Kesoram Industries Limited announced that Chief Financial Officer Samir Kumar Ray will step down from his role, effective January 2, 2027. The company filed this disclosure with the stock exchanges in line with regulatory requirements. Retail investors in Kesoram Industries should note upcoming leadership changes in the finance department as the transition date approaches.
why_it_matters: Leadership transition in finance well ahead of schedule
